tasks.story: As an implementer I can build and verify the selected stack from a clean checkout.
implementationTasks: Create projects/dependency rules
pin SDK/packages
CI restore/build/test commands
create authenticated skeleton and disposable PostgreSQL path.
tasks.acceptance: Clean build passes; verifier exits nonzero for missing required suite; no app credentials in repository.
tasks.tests: T01 build and negative verifier; T02 architecture boundary

tasks.story: As an operator I can initialise and upgrade the database reproducibly.
implementationTasks: Map core catalog/ingest/ops entities
generate migration
roles and constraints
fresh/N-1 migration harness.
tasks.acceptance: Fresh Postgres schema matches required constraints; runtime cannot DDL; migration evidence stored.
tasks.tests: T03 fresh DB / N-1 migration / constraint rejection

tasks.story: As a user my accepted work survives process restart.
implementationTasks: Implement queue/lease/fencing, attempt/checkpoint records, outbox/inbox and loop driver state schema.
tasks.acceptance: Worker crash before/after commit has one effect; expired worker cannot commit; attempts bounded.
tasks.tests: T04 kill-worker / duplicate delivery / stale lease

tasks.story: As an analyst I can import matches with row-level provenance.
implementationTasks: Stream CSV/JSON
preview counts
hashes and chunks
activate only complete batches
canonical sample fixtures.
tasks.acceptance: Quoted/newline/BOM import works; identical request idempotent; cancellation hides partial facts.
tasks.tests: T05 bounded CSV, idempotency and partial batch

tasks.story: As an analyst I can resolve source names without corrupting histories.
implementationTasks: Canonical leagues/seasons/teams
team/referee/bookmaker/market alias registry
decision API and quarantine.
tasks.acceptance: Ambiguous alias stays quarantined; reviewed remapping yields new version; old snapshots unchanged.

tasks.story: As an analyst I can reproduce what was knowable at a cutoff.
implementationTasks: Revision selector, source precedence, manifests, timing modes, metric DQ and hash canonicalization.
tasks.acceptance: Future/late revisions cannot change prior snapshot; missing data remains unavailable; same semantic input hashes deterministically.

tasks.story: As an analyst I can compute an explainable first score distribution.
implementationTasks: Pure PMF/tails, matrix and projector
analytic fixture
baseline league rates with cold-start disclosure.
tasks.acceptance: Analytic means1.2/.8 and complements pass; tails bounded; unsupported domain errors explicit.

tasks.story: As an analyst I can retrieve the exact forecast shown earlier.
implementationTasks: Persist distribution, prediction, projected markets and audit
fenced/idempotent creation
explain endpoint.
tasks.acceptance: No probability displayed before commit; correction cannot update journal; request repeat resolves original result.

tasks.story: As a user I can import/select a fixture and view its saved forecast.
implementationTasks: WinForms shell/presenter/API client
fixture context
loading/cancel/offline errors
number badges.
tasks.acceptance: Keyboard import→fixture→journal journey succeeds; stale async response cannot overwrite selection.
tasks.tests: T10 Windows journey and presenter cancellation

tasks.story: As an analyst I can compare complete compatible odds.
implementationTasks: Formats conversion, group identity/freshness, proportional de-vig, manual entry and original text.
tasks.acceptance: 2/3.3/4 yields exact139/132 book sum and66/139 home fair; incomplete groups rejected.
tasks.tests: T11 odds vectors and semantic mismatch

tasks.story: As an owner I can see what was preserved or deliberately changed.
implementationTasks: Recover frozen old assessment/formula inventory
map every Expected entry and all families
capture full golden inputs
label unsupported.
tasks.acceptance: 620 Expected entries individually accounted for against actual source; parity claims only for complete fixtures; audit totals reconciled.

tasks.story: As an analyst I get internally consistent derived markets.
implementationTasks: Typed DAG, stable topo execution, cache identities, failure propagation and hard/soft diagnostics.
tasks.acceptance: Cycles rejected; double chance sums2; BTTS subset bounds and monotone totals pass; quote changes only invalidate price descendants.

tasks.story: As an analyst I can inspect value delta and net payoff assumptions.
implementationTasks: Sign convention, costs/freshness checks, Odds and Value Lab UI, distributions and uncertainty placeholder state.
tasks.acceptance: Delta/EV fixture correct; percent points distinct; incompatible lines cannot compare; unavailable bands labelled.
tasks.tests: T14 value/cost arithmetic and UI semantics

tasks.story: As a simulator I settle whole, half and quarter markets correctly.
implementationTasks: Quarter-unit keys, win/push/half states, void/postponement rules, outcome evidence and correction events.
tasks.acceptance: Over2.75 at3 is half-win; -0.25 draw half-loss; exhaustive partitions and correction reversal pass.

tasks.story: As an analyst I run rolling tests without future information.
implementationTasks: Frozen RunSpec, inner/outer splits, weekly refits, checkpoints, held-out labels and result export.
tasks.acceptance: Future mutations leave prior decisions unchanged; cancelled/resumed run equals uninterrupted run; modes separate.

tasks.story: As an analyst I simulate executable decisions and exposure.
implementationTasks: Fixed/proportional/fractional Kelly, price selection, simultaneous reservations, commission/liquidity/limits and reversals.
tasks.acceptance: No borrowing unsettled winnings; same-time order invariant; exactly one logical ledger effect; all money reconciles.

tasks.story: As an analyst I compare a fitted goal candidate with baseline.
implementationTasks: Penalised fit/constraints/gradient, convergence and fallback diagnostics
versioned candidate search.
tasks.acceptance: Independent gradient checks; τ positivity; failed fit does not replace approved model; no held-out tuning.

tasks.story: As an analyst I see calibrated probabilities with meaningful bands.
implementationTasks: OOS atomic calibration,200-draw block bootstrap, mixture, quantiles and interval failure reporting.
tasks.acceptance: All draws/mixture coherent;≥180 successful draws gate; count intervals distinct from probability bands.

tasks.story: As an owner I compare proper scores and conditional paper performance.
implementationTasks: Brier/logloss/reliability/ECE, paired intervals, ROI/drawdown/CLV, report artifacts and cohorts.
tasks.acceptance: Hand-computed metric fixtures pass; empty cohorts null; reports expose assumptions, exclusions and all tried candidates.

tasks.story: As a user I inspect half and HT/FT markets reconciled to FT.
implementationTasks: Period shares/prior, conditional allocation and HT/FT projection
coverage gates.
tasks.acceptance: Summing allocations returns FT; unsupported halves unavailable; no half independence shortcut.

tasks.story: As a user I inspect shots/SOT/corners/cards/fouls/offsides honestly.
implementationTasks: NB fit/convolution, Poisson fallback, binomial SOT thinning, referee shrinkage and definition registry.
tasks.acceptance: SOT≤shots atoms; NB totals by convolution; each missing family independently unavailable with reasons.

tasks.story: As a user I understand historical performance and source coverage.
implementationTasks: Team perspectives, unique samples, ranks/ties/points, referee histories, recorded-xG distinction.
tasks.acceptance: Each fixture counted once; last-five overlap disclosed; n=0 unavailable; two league views independent.

tasks.story: As a user I navigate all specified analysis workflows.
implementationTasks: Finish market ladders, model lab, journal, data manager, profiles/help
exports and explanatory drill-downs.
tasks.acceptance: All11 analysis workspaces pass scripted journeys with loading/empty/partial/stale/error states.

tasks.story: As an owner I control which artifacts are trusted and see changes.
implementationTasks: Immutable config/calibration approval events, market lifecycle, audit browser and exact-hash promotion/rollback.
tasks.acceptance: Unapproved hash blocked; failed cohort quarantined independently; old forecast retains old approved artifact.

tasks.story: As an owner I learn when data or model quality deteriorates.
implementationTasks: Opt-in source schedules, coalescing/DST rules, stale data/job/disk alerts, rolling calibration drift.
tasks.acceptance: Restart coalesces missed work; dedupe alerts; drift cannot self-promote; small sample yields insufficient evidence.

tasks.story: As an owner I can recover evidence and safely prune cache.
implementationTasks: Database/artifact backup manifest, off-host encrypted option, restore drill and referenced-object retention graph.
tasks.acceptance: Fresh restore reproduces selected prediction/report; pruning cannot delete referenced payload; licence deletion marks dependent claims.

tasks.story: As an owner I can run privately with controlled permissions.
implementationTasks: Auth/secrets/ACLs/source allowlist, import limits, export escaping, SBOM and dependency lock review.
tasks.acceptance: No secret in diagnostics; unauthorized API denied; runtime cannot mutate immutable tables/DDL; malicious input tests pass.

tasks.story: As an owner I install and upgrade a verifiable personal release.
implementationTasks: Windows publish/service/client package, PostgreSQL setup, migration bundle, manifests and clean-machine smoke.
tasks.acceptance: Fresh install and N-1 upgrade run core journey; backup verified before migration; rollback/restore rehearsed.

tasks.story: As an owner I can distinguish validated from experimental markets.
implementationTasks: Freeze cohorts/holdout, run evaluation and model cards for at least2 leagues, inspect coverage/calibration/fallbacks.
tasks.acceptance: Per-cohort promotion criteria met or candidate stays experimental; no unsupported blanket accuracy claim.

tasks.story: As a user I operate with keyboard and my display culture.
implementationTasks: en-GB/pt-BR resources, DPI/high contrast, numeric tables for charts and offline/reconnect testing.
tasks.acceptance: 100/125/150/200%DPI and keyboard journeys pass; invariant storage unaffected by comma decimals.

tasks.story: As an owner I know the supported workload and remaining limits.
implementationTasks: Benchmark reference dataset/hardware, query plans/resource caps, full regression and release evidence.
tasks.acceptance: Targets met or explicit accepted scoped limit; no skipped Must gate; release hash matches tested artifacts.

tasks.story: As an owner I can operate the finished project without chat history.
implementationTasks: Complete user/operator docs, release notes, known issues, maintenance calendar, inventory and signed closure checklist.
tasks.acceptance: All Must tasks traced to merged/tested evidence; clean checkout/runbook rehearsal succeeds; owner acceptance recorded.

tasks.story: As an analyst I can compare justified margin-removal assumptions.
implementationTasks: Power/odds-ratio and optionally Shin only with full numerical specification/oracles
sensitivity report.
tasks.acceptance: Feasible roots/tails and input failures tested; methods clearly labelled; old snapshots unaffected.

tasks.story: As an owner I extend data/models without destabilising baseline.
implementationTasks: New source admission or candidate protocol, licence/timing evidence, isolated experiment and review.
tasks.acceptance: No adapter auto-enabled without rights; no model promoted without same evaluation gates.
